follow_ups.title: Fix pre-existing using-directive ordering in src/WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes reports IMPORTS on line 1, which was already there before this change, so a format check in CI may fail on this file.

follow_ups.title: Feature verification asks for a test stack scenario that was never created
follow_ups.reason: UI verification calls 'load <scenario description>' before any scenario for that description exists (only _base and default do), so it fails no matter what the code does.

follow_ups.title: GetItemById and UpdateItemV1 return application/json for 400s documented as application/problem+json
follow_ups.reason: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> is sent as application/json while their ProducesResponseType annotations declare application/problem+json, so clients and the OpenAPI document disagree.
